# IbuJS

> IbuJS is a small full-stack TypeScript + JSX framework that is secure by default and designed to be written by beginners and AI assistants. Browser code uses @ibujs/ui (signals + JSX); server code uses @ibujs/server (HTTP, validation, sessions, SQLite); AI features use @ibujs/ai (server-only Claude helpers). There is exactly one way to do each common task, and unsafe patterns either do not exist or throw an error with a code (IBUxxx) that `npx ibu explain IBUxxx` explains.

Project layout: `src/main.tsx` (browser), `src/server.ts` (server), `index.html`, `ibu.config.json`. Commands: `npm run dev`, `npm run build`, `npm start`, `npx ibu check`, `npx ibu ai "<task>"`, `npx ibu review`, `npx ibu explain <code>`, `npx ibu secret`, `npx ibu doctor`.

## Browser: @ibujs/ui

```tsx
import { createApp, hydrate, signal, computed, effect, batch, resource, createRouter, api, ApiError, nextTick } from '@ibujs/ui';

const count = signal(0);                 // read/write with count.value; count.update(n => n + 1)
const doubled = computed(() => count.value * 2);   // read-only, recomputed when count changes
effect(() => console.log(count.value));  // re-runs when signals it reads change; may return a cleanup fn
batch(() => { a.value = 1; b.value = 2; });   // one update for several writes
count.peek();                            // read without subscribing

function Counter() {
  return <button onClick={() => count.value++}>Clicked {count} times</button>;  // {count} renders a signal
}
createApp(Counter, '#app');              // re-renders automatically (batched per microtask)
```

How updates work: each component tracks the signals it reads and re-renders on its own when they change (parents first, batched per microtask); the rest of the page is untouched. A component whose props are shallow-equal to last time is skipped, so pass new objects/arrays when data changes. If a component throws while rendering, only that component keeps its last output and the error goes to `createApp(view, target, { onError })` (dev shows an overlay); siblings keep working.

Hydration: when the server already sent the HTML (`renderToString` / `renderPage`), use `hydrate(App, '#app')` instead of `createApp`. It adopts the existing DOM (no flash, focus kept) and attaches events. If the HTML does not match what App renders, it warns with IBU206 and renders fresh.

JSX rules:
- Components are functions of props returning JSX, strings, numbers, arrays, null or booleans.
- Events: `onClick={fn}`, `onInput`, `onChange`, `onSubmit`, `onKeyDown`… always functions, never strings.
- Two-way binding for inputs: `const name = signal(''); <input bind={name} />` (checkbox → boolean, number signal → number, radio → value).
- `class` accepts a string, array or object: `class={['btn', { active: isActive }]}`. `className` also works.
- `style` accepts an object (`style={{ fontSize: 18, color: 'red' }}`, numbers get px) or a CSS string.
- Lists need a unique stable `key`: `{items.value.map(i => <li key={i.id}>{i.name}</li>)}`.
- Refs: `<input ref={el => el?.focus()} />` or `ref={{ current: null }}`.
- Changing arrays/objects: assign a new one: `todos.update(list => [...list, todo])` (never `todos.value.push(...)`).
- Not available on purpose: innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, srcdoc, <script>, <base>, string event handlers. Text is always escaped. Unsafe URLs (javascript:, data:text/html…) in href/src/action are replaced with about:blank#blocked.
- Rendering a plain object as a child throws IBU106; render its fields.

Data loading:
```tsx
const notes = resource(() => api.get<Note[]>('/api/notes'));   // { data, loading, error } signals + refresh(), mutate(v)
// options: { lazy: true } to load later with notes.refresh(); { initial: [] }
{notes.loading.value && <p>Loading…</p>}
{notes.error.value && <p>Could not load notes</p>}
{(notes.data.value ?? []).map(n => <li key={n.id}>{n.text}</li>)}
```

Calling your server (same origin only, cookies included, 15s timeout, JSON in/out):
```ts
await api.get<T>('/api/notes');
await api.post<T>('/api/notes', { text });          // also api.put, api.patch, api.delete(path)
try { ... } catch (err) { if (err instanceof ApiError) show(err.message, err.status, err.data); }
for await (const chunk of api.stream('/api/ask', { prompt })) answer.value += chunk;  // streamed text (AI)
```

Routing:
```tsx
const router = createRouter([
  { path: '/', component: Home },
  { path: '/notes/:id', component: ({ id }) => <Note id={id} /> },
  { path: '/docs/*', component: params => <Docs path={params['*']} /> }
], () => <NotFound />, { mode: 'history' });      // mode: 'hash' for static hosting; base: '/app'
const { Link } = router;
<Link href="/notes/1">Open</Link>                 // real <a>, in-app navigation, aria-current on the active link
router.navigate('/notes', { replace: false });    // same-site paths only
router.path.value; router.query().get('q'); router.isActive('/notes');
{router.view()}                                   // renders the current route
```
History mode needs the server to send index.html for page URLs: `serveStatic(publicDir(), { spa: true })`.

Server-side rendering: `renderToString(<App />)` returns escaped HTML (SafeHtml). `html\`<p>${text}</p>\`` escapes interpolations.

## Server: @ibujs/server

```ts
import { createServer, s, HttpError, logger, rateLimit, serveStatic, publicDir, sqliteDatabase, createSessionManager, hashPassword, verifyPassword, renderPage, html } from '@ibujs/server';

const app = createServer();            // options: { trustProxy, maxBodyBytes, cors: { origins: [...] }, csrf, dev, onError }
app.use(logger());
app.use(rateLimit({ limit: 300 }));    // per visitor per minute; per route: app.post('/api/login', rateLimit({ limit: 5 }), handler)

const NewNote = s.object({ text: s.string({ min: 1, max: 500 }) });
app.post('/api/notes', async ctx => {
  const { text } = await ctx.body(NewNote);        // validated + typed; unknown keys dropped; 400 with issues on failure
  const [note] = await db.sql`INSERT INTO notes (text) VALUES (${text}) RETURNING *`;
  ctx.json(note, 201);
});
app.get('/api/notes/:id', async ctx => {
  const id = s.number({ coerce: true, integer: true }).parse(ctx.params.id);
  const [note] = await db.sql`SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ${id}`;
  if (!note) throw new HttpError(404, 'Note not found');   // message is sent to the client
  ctx.json(note);
});
app.use(serveStatic(publicDir(), { spa: true }));
app.listen(Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000), process.env.HOST ?? '127.0.0.1');
```

Context (`ctx`): `params`, `query` (URLSearchParams), `ip`, `secure`, `state`, `requestId`, `req`, `res`;
responses `ctx.json(data, status?)`, `ctx.text(str)`, `ctx.html(safeHtml)`, `ctx.empty(204)`, `ctx.redirect('/path')` (same-site only; `{ allowExternal: true }` for vetted URLs);
`await ctx.body(schema?)` (JSON only, 1 MB default), `ctx.cookies.get/set/delete` (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS by default).
Routes: `app.get/post/put/patch/delete(path, ...middleware, handler)`; middleware is `async (ctx, next) => { ...; await next(); }`.
Errors: throw `new HttpError(status, message)`; other exceptions become a generic 500 and are logged with the request id.
Built in: security headers + CSP, CSRF protection (cross-site POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE from browsers are blocked), request ids, 405/HEAD handling, slow-client timeouts.

Validation (`s`): `s.string({ min, max (default 10000), pattern, email, url, trim })`, `s.number({ min, max, integer, coerce })`, `s.boolean()`, `s.enum(['a','b'])`, `s.id()`, `s.array(item, { min, max })`, `s.object(shape, { strict })`, `.optional()`, `.default(v)`, `schema.parse(v)`, `schema.safeParse(v)`, `type T = Infer<typeof schema>`.

Database:
```ts
const db = await sqliteDatabase(process.env.DATABASE_FILE ?? 'data.db');   // built-in SQLite (Node 22.13+)
await db.raw(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, text TEXT NOT NULL)`);
const rows = await db.sql<Note>`SELECT * FROM notes WHERE owner = ${userId} ORDER BY id DESC`;   // values are always parameters
sql.identifier(column)   // for validated dynamic column names; sql`` fragments can be nested
```
Never build SQL text from strings; `db.query()` only accepts sql``. `db.raw(text, params)` is for static SQL. `memoryDatabase()` is an in-memory store for prototypes (insert/find/update/remove/all).

Auth:
```ts
const sessions = createSessionManager({ secret: process.env.SESSION_SECRET! });   // 32+ bytes; `npx ibu secret`
const hash = await hashPassword(password);              // scrypt; 12+ chars required (HttpError 400 otherwise)
const ok = await verifyPassword(password, user?.password_hash);   // pass undefined when the user does not exist
sessions.login(ctx, String(user.id));                   // sets a secure cookie
const session = await sessions.require(ctx);            // 401 if not logged in; session.sub is the user id
sessions.logout(ctx);
```

Authorization (who may touch which record; everything not listed is denied):
```ts
import { definePolicy, owner, role, loggedIn, anyOf, allOf, actorFromSession } from '@ibujs/server';
const notes = definePolicy<Note>({
  read: anyOf(owner('owner_id'), (user, note) => note.is_public === 1),
  update: owner('owner_id'),
  delete: anyOf(owner('owner_id'), role('admin'))
});
app.put('/api/notes/:id', async ctx => {
  const user = actorFromSession(await sessions.require(ctx));      // { id, roles } (roles from sessions.login(ctx, id, { roles: 'admin' }))
  const [note] = await db.sql<Note>`SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ${id}`;
  if (!note) throw new HttpError(404, 'Note not found');
  await notes.authorize(user, 'update', note);                     // 401 not logged in, 403 not allowed; { hide: true } → 404
  ...
});
const visible = await notes.filter(user, 'read', rows);              // await notes.can(user, 'read', note) → boolean
```
Rules are `true`, `false`, `loggedIn` or `(actor, record) => boolean | Promise<boolean>`; `allOf(...)` needs every rule; `owner(field)` compares `String(record[field])` with the actor id. Load the record first, then authorize; never trust an owner id sent by the browser.

Pages from the server: `ctx.html(renderPage({ title, body: <App />, scripts: ['/app.js'], styles: ['/app.css'] }))`, then `hydrate(App, '#app')` in the browser.

## AI: @ibujs/ai (server only)

```ts
import { createAI } from '@ibujs/ai';
const ai = createAI({ system: 'You help users write recipes.' });   // reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; model claude-opus-5-5
app.post('/api/ask', ai.route());                     // body { prompt } or { messages }; streams text; rate-limited, size-limited
const text = await ai.ask('Summarise: ' + note.text); // whole answer
for await (const chunk of ai.stream(prompt)) { ... }
```
Options: `model`, `system`, `effort` ('low'…'max'), `maxTokens`; route options add `maxInputChars` (4000), `requestsPerMinute` (10), `maxConcurrent` (4). Never import @ibujs/ai in browser code (the build fails if you do).

## AI coding: `npx ibu ai "<task>"`

Claude edits the code, then the CLI typechecks and security-checks the result and sends any failures back to Claude in the same conversation (up to `--fix-rounds=N`, default 2, max 5). Flags: `--dry-run` (show the plan only), `--yes` (no prompts), `--branch[=name]` (new git branch, commits only the files it wrote), `--test` (also run `npm test`), `--no-verify`, `--effort=low|medium|high|xhigh|max`. Files outside the project, secrets and generated folders are never written.

## Deploy

- Any Node 22.13+ host: `npm run build && npm start` (set `PORT`, `HOST=0.0.0.0`, `NODE_ENV=production`).
- Vercel: `ibu build --target=vercel` writes `.vercel/output` (static files on the CDN, `src/server.ts` as one function). New apps include a vercel.json for this (`npm run build:vercel`), so importing the repo on Vercel just works. Set secrets (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, SESSION_SECRET) in the project's Environment Variables. SQLite files there are temporary (IBU604); use a hosted database for data that must last.
- New apps: `npx create-ibujs my-app` (or `npx ibu create my-app --npm`); `--vendor` copies the framework source into the app.

## Optional

- Errors: every IbuJS error has a code; `npx ibu explain --list`.
- Security model and audit: docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md, SECURITY.md.
